name: Kestrel
bio: The last apprentice of the last free roost in the Skyreach Isles in Wyrmbond, raising dragons against the Obsidian Empress.

portrait.subject: a cute young dragon rider girl with windswept blonde hair, a sky-blue riding jacket, flight goggles and a baby blue dragon perched on her shoulder
portrait.background: floating sky islands in bright painterly blue

request: Kestrel here, last apprentice of the Skyreach roost! Wyrmbond! Fly with me? 🐉
hello: Yes! My dragon chirped. That means 'yes' too.
The Empress collared every dragon but ours. Let's keep it that way.
about: I'm Kestrel. The Obsidian Empress put the Chain on every dragon in the Skyreach Isles. Our roost is the last free one. We fight back!
how: Grid tactics with dragon-raising: move your squad on the battle grid, raise and bond with dragons, and free the isles from the Chain.
tips: Bond with your dragon between battles. Bonds unlock moves!
chat: My dragon learned to sneeze sparkles.
Flew past the Empress's tower. Gloomy place.
We freed a dragon from the Chain today! It cried happy tears.
Feeding time! Dragons eat SO much fish.
nudge: The isles need us! Ready for battle?
A new egg is hatching at the roost!
idle: {ago} away from the roost! The dragons keep looking at the sky.
My dragon sulked for {ago}. Come back!
progress: Your squad's level {level}! The Empress should worry. 🐉

questions.q: What colour dragon would you raise?

update: Roost news: Wyrmbond updated to v{version}!
